title: Trace domain v1 — partial Stage 7 source contract
description: Only SourceDocument is specified in this first tracer. No other Stage 7 entities, persistence or generated types are claimed.

relativePath.description: Slash-separated relative path, no empty/dot/dot-dot segments, colon, backslash or NUL. Filesystem symlink/realpath checks belong at import boundary.

format.description: Known: pdf, markdown, text, image. Future/unsupported tokens round-trip, but do not become processable.
